title: Mark Phylogenetic tree ready to clear processing overlay
observed_behavior: When these uploaded non-Newick tree-capable inputs are launched with default view set to Phylogenetic Tree, the Processing Files overlay can remain visible indefinitely and the tree never becomes interactive.
intended_behavior: The Processing Files overlay should clear and the uploaded data should reach an interactive Phylogenetic Tree on the direct-launch path for computed-tree inputs.
cause_summary: Phylogenetic direct launch did not mark the tree view as rendered after `openTree()` completed, so tree-first launches could leave the processing overlay open even though the view data was ready.
fix_summary: `PhylogeneticComponent` now publishes `store.setNetworkRendered(true)` after the tree is built and styled, and the maintained direct-launch regression smoke now covers the four previously blocked computed-source profiles.
notes: Confirmed locally on 2026-04-04 with direct-launch coverage for edgelist, matrix, FASTA, and sequence-node-list inputs. The stable launch-then-switch smoke still passes.

title: Sync Phylogenetic leaf color-table transparency
observed_behavior: Changing a node color-table transparency slider recolored Phylogenetic Tree leaves but left leaf fills fully opaque.
intended_behavior: Phylogenetic leaf node fills should use the global node color-table alpha, including when global custom leaf shapes are enabled.
cause_summary: The tree leaf styling path read `nodeColorMap` but always assigned `fill-opacity: 1`, and generated custom-shape overlays did not encode any fill opacity.
fix_summary: Leaf styling now uses the shared node fill-style helper and passes fill opacity into tree shape SVG generation while keeping strokes opaque.
notes: Covered by a view-state regression that changes the color-table alpha and asserts leaf circle fill opacity.
